author_says.description: 8-bit sequential square root extractor
author_says.notes: Once the button is pressed, it takes 2 ticks to initiate the circuit. The Square Root is saved 4 rTicks after the Remainder, and the circuit is cleared for 1 cycle, 1 rTick after the Root is saved. 1 cycle lasts 13 rTicks, so it takes 8t for init, 4 clock cycles, and 11 ticks to finish saving and clearing. This uses a Non-restoring / trial subtraction Binary Digit-by-Digit Square Root Algorithm.

notes: In MCHPRS the circuit never goes fully still after a run, so results were read 300 ticks after the press (the author gives about 71). The Extract button is an oak button, which MCHPRS does not load; the test used a stone button pressed for 15 ticks like oak. With a 10-tick (stone) press the results are wrong for some inputs.
